title: LED Light Bar Spot/Flood – 12/24V Work Light
descriptionHtml:
See more when darkness falls

Standard headlights are rarely enough on dark roads and off-road. Poor visibility makes driving both slow and unsafe.

Powerful light with spot and flood

This light bar combines spot and flood light for both long reach and wide light. It fits 12V and 24V and lights up the road ahead of you.

Features

  • Combines spot and flood light
  • Fits 12V and 24V
  • Powerful, energy-efficient LED light
  • Tough construction for off-road use
  • Great for cars, trucks, 4x4s and boats

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
